preregistration.title: Prevalence-gated adaptation (PGA) on ASVspoof 2021 DF
preregistration.fixed_on: 2026-10-21, before any ASVspoof 2021 DF score was computed
preregistration.discovery_data: In-the-Wild (kill test, 21 Oct 2026): adaptation helped only at a 96% spoof share
preregistration.confirmatory_data: SpeechAntiSpoofingBenchmarks/ASVspoof2021_DF, all 80 shards, revision pinned in runs/df21_v1/config.json
preregistration.detector: authors' SSL-AASIST LA checkpoint, frozen; score = bona - spoof logit
preregistration.gate_estimator: pilot_pga_g.estimate_bona_share on the frozen score (calibration half of the reference vs traffic)
preregistration.classifier: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, class_weight=balanced), 5-fold cross-fitting, fold-matched calibration
preregistration.reference: 1000 genuine clips: 500 train, 500 calibration; speaker-overlap mode primary, speaker-disjoint secondary
preregistration.spoof_shares: 0.05, 0.20, 0.50, 0.80, 0.90 and the natural share of the corpus
preregistration.H1: gain: at natural share and 0.90, mean EER(PGA) <= 0.85 x mean EER(frozen) and mean anchor HTER(PGA) < frozen
preregistration.H2: safety: at 0.05, 0.20, 0.50, mean EER(PGA) <= 1.02 x mean EER(frozen)
preregistration.H3: FRR: mean anchor FRR(PGA) <= 0.06 in every cell
preregistration.H4: shortcut: mean shortcut AUC(PGA) <= 0.60 in every cell
preregistration.decision: H1-H4 all pass -> method confirmed; otherwise route 1

public_record_status: terminology-normalized copy of historical protocol; source checksum in provenance/record-scope.json
